units.source_text: 过了约莫几分钟，大石内藏助谎称去如厕离席，他一个人靠着檐廊的柱子，静静看着古老庭院里青苔和石头中间开放的鲜艳梅花。

en.t: After a few minutes had passed, Oishi Kuranosuke falsely said he was going to the privy and left his seat; alone, he leaned against a veranda pillar and quietly looked at the vivid plum blossoms blooming among the moss and stones in the old garden.

units.source_text: 夕阳日薄，暮色侵染了院中竹林。

en.t: The evening sun was fading, and dusk had begun to stain the bamboo grove in the garden.

units.source_text: 可是，纸拉门内还在兴致勃勃的高谈阔论。

en.t: Yet inside the paper sliding doors, the lively, spirited discussion was still going on.

units.source_text: 听着他们谈笑风生，他觉得悲哀包围了自己，伴随着梅花的香气，一直凉到自己的内心深处。

en.t: As he listened to their cheerful conversation, he felt sorrow closing around him, and with the fragrance of the plum blossoms it chilled him all the way to the depths of his heart.

units.source_text: 这种寂寞，这种难以名状的寂寞，究竟是从何而来的呢——

en.t: Where, after all, had this loneliness, this indescribable loneliness, come from?

units.source_text: 内藏助抬头望着好像镶嵌在天空中冰冷洁白的花朵，久久的站在那里。

en.t: Kuranosuke raised his head and gazed at the cold white blossoms that seemed to be set into the sky, standing there for a long time.
